# Recon GPR

> Recon GPR is a Concrete contractor serving Castle Rock, Colorado. Recon GPR provides independent third-party concrete scanning and subsurface locating across Denver, the Front Range, and Colorado mountain communities. We map rebar grids, post-tension cables, and embedded conduits—marking clear safe-zones directly on site so your crew can core,
